```{r config}
OUT_DIR   <- "D:/桌面/movie-recommendation-dissertation/06_models/output/07_M1_M2"

FIG_DIR <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "figs_dissertation")
dir.create(FIG_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

SEED     <- 2024L
SVD_DIM  <- 16L
K_LEVELS <- 5L
LEVELS5  <- 1:5
CUTS     <- c(1.5, 2.5, 3.5, 4.5)
N_BOOT   <- 500L

set.seed(SEED)

# ---- one visual identity for every dissertation figure ---------------
# Okabe-Ito palette (colour-blind safe); models keep the same colour

theme_pub <- function(base_size = 12) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          plot.title = element_text(size = base_size, face = "plain"),
          legend.position = "bottom",
          plot.margin = margin(t = 8, r = 16, b = 8, l = 8))
}

save_fig <- function(name, plot, w = 6.5, h = 4.0) {
  plot <- plot + labs(subtitle = NULL, caption = NULL)
  ggsave(file.path(FIG_DIR, name), plot,
         width = w, height = h, units = "in", dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  invisible(plot)
}
```

## 1. Load the Selection and All Cached Models

```{r load-data}
sel   <- readRDS(SEL_FILE)
fit   <- as.data.table(sel$fit)
calib <- as.data.table(sel$calib)
test  <- as.data.table(sel$test)

to_int5 <- function(d) { d[, rating5 := as.integer(as.character(rating5))]; d[] }
fit <- to_int5(fit); calib <- to_int5(calib); test <- to_int5(test)

user_map  <- data.table(userId  = sort(unique(fit$userId)))[,  user_idx  := .I]
movie_map <- data.table(movieId = sort(unique(fit$movieId)))[, movie_idx := .I]
add_idx <- function(d) {
  d <- merge(d, user_map,  by = "userId",  all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
  d <- merge(d, movie_map, by = "movieId", all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
  setDT(d)
  d[, cold := is.na(user_idx) | is.na(movie_idx)]
  d[]
}
fit   <- add_idx(fit)[cold == FALSE]
calib <- add_idx(calib)[cold == FALSE]
test  <- add_idx(test)[cold == FALSE]

nU <- nrow(user_map); nI <- nrow(movie_map)
stopifnot(nrow(fit) == 393364L)

svd_cache <- readRDS(file.path(CACHE_DIR, "svd_factors.rds"))
stopifnot(identical(as.integer(svd_cache$user_map$userId),   as.integer(user_map$userId)),
          identical(as.integer(svd_cache$movie_map$movieId), as.integer(movie_map$movieId)),
          svd_cache$dim == SVD_DIM)
Pmat <- svd_cache$P; Qmat <- svd_cache$Q

m2c_par <- readRDS(file.path(CACHE_DIR, "m2c_params.rds"))
m2d <- readRDS(file.path(CACHE_DIR, "m2d_final.rds"))
stopifnot(abs(m2d$best_ll - (-1.10002)) < 2e-4)   # stale-cache guard, as in 10
m2e <- readRDS(file.path(CACHE_DIR, "m2e_final.rds"))
cat(sprintf("M2d best epoch %d (calib %.5f) | M2e best epoch %d (calib %.5f)\n",
            m2d$best_epoch, m2d$best_ll, m2e$best_epoch, m2e$best_ll))
```

## 2. Rebuild the Six Predictive Matrices



```{r core-functions}
sigmoid <- function(x) 1 / (1 + exp(-pmin(pmax(x, -30), 30)))
expand_thresholds <- function(t1, beta) c(t1, t1 + cumsum(exp(beta)))
tidy_probs <- function(P) { P <- pmax(P, 1e-12); P / rowSums(P) }

gauss_probs <- function(y, sigma) {
  y  <- as.numeric(y)
  CP <- sapply(CUTS, function(c) pnorm((c - y) / sigma))
  if (is.null(dim(CP))) CP <- matrix(CP, nrow = length(y))
  cbind(CP[, 1], CP[, 2:4] - CP[, 1:3], 1 - CP[, 4])
}
cum_probs <- function(theta, eta) {
  eta <- as.numeric(eta)
  CP  <- sapply(theta, function(t) plogis(t - eta))
  if (is.null(dim(CP))) CP <- matrix(CP, nrow = length(eta))
  cbind(CP[, 1], CP[, 2:4] - CP[, 1:3], 1 - CP[, 4])
}
calc_scores_d <- function(par, u, i)
  par$bi[i] + par$bu[u] + rowSums(par$P[u, , drop = FALSE] * par$Q[i, , drop = FALSE])
ordrec_probs_d <- function(par, u, i) {
  y  <- calc_scores_d(par, u, i)
  th <- expand_thresholds(par$t1, par$beta)
  CP <- sapply(th, function(t) plogis(t - y))
  if (is.null(dim(CP))) CP <- matrix(CP, nrow = length(y))
  cbind(CP[, 1], CP[, 2:4] - CP[, 1:3], 1 - CP[, 4])
}
calc_scores_e <- function(par, u, i)
  par$bi[i] + rowSums(par$P[u, , drop = FALSE] * par$Q[i, , drop = FALSE])
user_threshold_rows <- function(par, u) {
  E <- exp(par$beta[u, , drop = FALSE]); t1 <- par$t1[u]
  cbind(t1, t1 + E[, 1], t1 + E[, 1] + E[, 2], t1 + E[, 1] + E[, 2] + E[, 3])
}
ordrec_probs_e <- function(par, u, i) {
  y  <- calc_scores_e(par, u, i)
  CP <- plogis(user_threshold_rows(par, u) - y)
  cbind(CP[, 1], CP[, 2:4] - CP[, 1:3], 1 - CP[, 4])
}

metric_set <- function(P, y) {
  y   <- as.integer(y); P <- tidy_probs(P); n <- nrow(P)
  ll  <- log(P[cbind(seq_len(n), y)])
  E   <- as.numeric(P %*% LEVELS5)
  CP  <- t(apply(P, 1, cumsum))
  IND <- outer(y, LEVELS5, function(a, b) as.numeric(a <= b))
  rps <- rowSums((CP[, 1:(K_LEVELS - 1)] - IND[, 1:(K_LEVELS - 1)])^2) / (K_LEVELS - 1)
  list(row_ll = ll,
       tbl = data.table(meanLL = mean(ll),
                        RMSE   = sqrt(mean((y - E)^2)),
                        RPS    = mean(rps),
                        CatAcc = mean(max.col(P, ties.method = "first") == y)))
}
ndcg_per_user <- function(score, y, uid, min_items = 5L) {
  d <- data.table(uid = uid, s = as.numeric(score), rel = 2^as.integer(y) - 1)
  d <- d[, if (.N >= min_items) .SD, by = uid]
  d[, {
    k    <- min(10L, .N)
    dcg  <- sum(rel[order(-s)][1:k]   / log2(seq_len(k) + 1))
    idcg <- sum(rel[order(-rel)][1:k] / log2(seq_len(k) + 1))
    .(ndcg = if (idcg > 0) dcg / idcg else NA_real_)
  }, by = uid]
}
fcp_stat <- function(score, y, uid, min_items = 5L) {
  d <- data.table(uid = uid, s = as.numeric(score), y = as.integer(y))
  d <- d[, if (.N >= min_items) .SD, by = uid]
  per_user <- d[, {
    sy_gt <- outer(y, y, `>`); sy_lt <- outer(y, y, `<`)
    ss_gt <- outer(s, s, `>`); ss_ge <- outer(s, s, `>=`)
    list(nc = sum(ss_gt & sy_gt), nd = sum(ss_ge & sy_lt))
  }, by = uid]
  nc <- sum(per_user$nc); nd <- sum(per_user$nd)
  list(FCP = nc / (nc + nd), n_pairs = nc + nd, n_users = uniqueN(d$uid))
}
```

```{r rebuild-models}
svd_score_vec <- function(u, i)
  rowSums(Pmat[u, , drop = FALSE] * Qmat[i, , drop = FALSE])
calib[, svd_score := svd_score_vec(user_idx, movie_idx)]
test[,  svd_score := svd_score_vec(user_idx, movie_idx)]
calib[, svd_clip := pmin(pmax(svd_score, 1), 5)]
test[,  svd_clip := pmin(pmax(svd_score, 1), 5)]

sigma_m1 <- sqrt(mean((as.numeric(calib$rating5) - calib$svd_clip)^2))
P_m1 <- gauss_probs(test$svd_clip, sigma_m1)

calib[, rating_f := factor(rating5, levels = LEVELS5, ordered = TRUE)]
m2a <- clm(rating_f ~ svd_score, data = calib, link = "logit",
           threshold = "equidistant")
m2b <- clm(rating_f ~ svd_score, data = calib, link = "logit",
           threshold = "flexible")
th_a <- as.numeric(m2a$alpha); b_a <- as.numeric(m2a$beta)
th_a <- th_a[1] + (0:3) * th_a[2]
th_b <- as.numeric(m2b$alpha); b_b <- as.numeric(m2b$beta)
P_m2a <- cum_probs(th_a, b_a * test$svd_score)
P_m2b <- cum_probs(th_b, b_b * test$svd_score)

bu_c <- m2c_par$ranef[as.character(test$userId)]
bu_c[is.na(bu_c)] <- 0
P_m2c <- cum_probs(m2c_par$Theta, m2c_par$beta * test$svd_score + as.numeric(bu_c))

th_d  <- expand_thresholds(m2d$par$t1, m2d$par$beta)
P_m2d <- ordrec_probs_d(m2d$par, test$user_idx, test$movie_idx)
P_m2e <- ordrec_probs_e(m2e$par, test$user_idx, test$movie_idx)

P_list <- list(M1 = P_m1, M2a = P_m2a, M2b = P_m2b,
               M2c = P_m2c, M2d = P_m2d, M2e = P_m2e)
res_list <- lapply(P_list, metric_set, y = test$rating5)
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 3. Tables

```{r master-table}
metrics <- rbindlist(lapply(names(res_list), function(m)
  cbind(data.table(model = m), res_list[[m]]$tbl)))
rank_tbl <- rbindlist(lapply(names(P_list), function(m) {
  E <- as.numeric(tidy_probs(P_list[[m]]) %*% LEVELS5)
  f <- fcp_stat(E, test$rating5, test$userId)
  data.table(model = m,
             NDCG10 = mean(ndcg_per_user(E, test$rating5, test$userId)$ndcg,
                           na.rm = TRUE),
             FCP = f$FCP)
}))
master <- merge(metrics, rank_tbl, by = "model")[
  order(match(model, MODEL_LEVELS))]
kable(master, digits = 4, caption = "Test month, all six models, all six metrics")
fwrite(master, file.path(OUT_DIR, "ladder_master_table.csv"))

# guard: this file must reproduce 10's numbers exactly
stopifnot(abs(master[model == "M2e", meanLL] - (-1.154440)) < 1e-4,
          abs(master[model == "M2d", meanLL] - (-1.185765)) < 1e-4)

# fit-calib gaps at the kept epoch, for the overfitting discussion
gap_tbl <- data.table(
  model = c("M2d", "M2e"),
  best_epoch = c(m2d$best_epoch, m2e$best_epoch),
  fit_calib_gap = c(m2d$history[epoch == m2d$best_epoch, fit_meanLL - calib_meanLL],
                    m2e$history[epoch == m2e$best_epoch, fit_meanLL - calib_meanLL]))
kable(gap_tbl, digits = 4, caption = "Fit-calibration gap at the kept epoch")
fwrite(gap_tbl, file.path(OUT_DIR, "m2de_fitcalib_gaps.csv"))
```

## 4. Cluster Bootstrap 

```{r bootstrap}
ll_mat <- do.call(cbind, lapply(res_list, function(r) r$row_ll))
colnames(ll_mat) <- names(res_list)
rows_by_user <- split(seq_len(nrow(test)), test$userId)
u_names <- names(rows_by_user)

set.seed(SEED)
others <- setdiff(colnames(ll_mat), "M1")
cmp_names <- c(paste0(others, " - M1"), "M2d - M2c", "M2e - M2d")
boot <- matrix(NA_real_, N_BOOT, length(cmp_names),
               dimnames = list(NULL, cmp_names))
for (b in seq_len(N_BOOT)) {
  idx <- unlist(rows_by_user[sample(u_names, length(u_names), replace = TRUE)],
                use.names = FALSE)
  mm  <- colMeans(ll_mat[idx, , drop = FALSE])
  boot[b, ] <- c(mm[others] - mm["M1"], mm["M2d"] - mm["M2c"],
                 mm["M2e"] - mm["M2d"])
}
obs <- colMeans(ll_mat)
obs_diff <- c(obs[others] - obs["M1"], obs["M2d"] - obs["M2c"],
              obs["M2e"] - obs["M2d"])
ci <- data.table(comparison  = colnames(boot),
                 diff_meanLL = as.numeric(obs_diff),
                 lo = apply(boot, 2, quantile, 0.025),
                 hi = apply(boot, 2, quantile, 0.975))
ci[, significant := (lo > 0) | (hi < 0)]
kable(ci, digits = 5, caption = "Cluster bootstrap (users resampled, 500 reps)")
```

## 5. Figures



### 5.1 The ladder with uncertainty 

```{r p1-ladder, fig.height=3.8}
lad <- ci[grepl(" - M1$", comparison)]
lad[, model := factor(sub(" - M1$", "", comparison), levels = MODEL_LEVELS)]
p1 <- ggplot(lad, aes(model, diff_meanLL)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey55") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), linewidth = 0.7, size = 0.5,
                  colour = "#D55E00") +
  theme_pub() +
  labs(title = "Gain in test mean log-likelihood over M1, by model", 
       x = NULL, y = "Gain in mean log-likelihood over M1")
print(p1)
save_fig("p01_ladder_meanLL_ci.png", p1, w = 6.5, h = 3.8)
```

### 5.2 Where the gains come from: incremental waterfall 

```{r p2-waterfall, fig.height=3.8}
step_lab <- c("M1 \u2192 M2a\nordinal link",
              "M2a \u2192 M2b\nfree spacing",
              "M2b \u2192 M2c\nuser intercept",
              "M2c \u2192 M2d\njoint training",
              "M2d \u2192 M2e\nper-user thresholds")
mm <- master[match(MODEL_LEVELS, model), meanLL]
wf <- data.table(step = factor(step_lab, levels = step_lab),
                 gain = diff(mm),
                 to_model = MODEL_LEVELS[-1])
p2 <- ggplot(wf, aes(step, gain, fill = to_model)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.62) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("+%.4f", gain)), vjust = -0.45, size = 3.1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = MODEL_COLS, guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.14))) +
  theme_pub() +
  labs(title = "Incremental gain of each rung of the ladder",
       subtitle = "Test-month mean log-likelihood.\nThe two joint-training steps (M2d, M2e) contribute more than the three frozen-factor steps combined.",
       x = NULL, y = expression(Delta * " mean log-likelihood"))
print(p2)
save_fig("p02_incremental_waterfall.png", p2, w = 7.6, h = 4.0)
```

### 5.3 Likelihood vs ranking: two different kinds of gain 

```{r p3-decomposition, fig.height=4.0}
nd <- master[match(MODEL_LEVELS, model), NDCG10]
dec <- rbind(
  data.table(step = factor(step_lab, levels = step_lab),
             metric = "\u0394 mean log-likelihood", value = diff(mm),
             to_model = MODEL_LEVELS[-1]),
  data.table(step = factor(step_lab, levels = step_lab),
             metric = "\u0394 NDCG@10", value = diff(nd),
             to_model = MODEL_LEVELS[-1]))
p3 <- ggplot(dec, aes(step, value, fill = to_model)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.62) +
  facet_wrap(~ metric, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = MODEL_COLS, guide = "none") +
  theme_pub() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8)) +
  labs(title = "Calibration gains vs. ranking gains are carried by different steps",
       subtitle = "Frozen-factor steps (M2a-M2c) cannot move NDCG (identical scores by algebra).\nJoint training (M2d) moves ranking most; per-user thresholds (M2e) move likelihood most.",
       x = NULL, y = NULL)
print(p3)
save_fig("p03_likelihood_vs_ranking.png", p3, w = 6.8, h = 4.6)
```

### 5.4 The RMSE decoupling story 

```{r p4-decoupling, fig.height=4.0}
dc <- master[, .(model, RMSE, meanLL)]
dc[, model := factor(model, levels = MODEL_LEVELS)]
setorder(dc, model)
p4 <- ggplot(dc, aes(RMSE, meanLL)) +
  geom_path(colour = "grey65", linewidth = 0.5,
            arrow = arrow(length = unit(5, "pt"), type = "closed")) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = model), size = 2.6) +
  geom_text(aes(label = model, colour = model),
            vjust = -0.9, size = 3.2, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = MODEL_COLS, guide = "none") +
  scale_x_reverse(expand = expansion(mult = 0.15)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.08)) +
  theme_pub() +
  labs(title = "Ordinalisation first sacrifices RMSE, joint training wins it back",
       subtitle = "Path follows the ladder. M2a/M2b trade RMSE for likelihood; M2d/M2e beat M1 on both,\nechoing Koren & Sill's Netflix result. x-axis reversed: right = better.",
       x = "RMSE (reversed: right = better)", y = "Mean log-likelihood (up = better)")
print(p4)
save_fig("p04_rmse_decoupling.png", p4, w = 7.2, h = 4.6)
```

### 5.5 Threshold spacing across the ladder


```{r p5-spacing, fig.height=3.6}
Tall <- user_threshold_rows(m2e$par, seq_len(nU))
gaps_e <- data.table(user_idx = seq_len(nU),
                     g12 = Tall[, 2] - Tall[, 1],
                     g23 = Tall[, 3] - Tall[, 2],
                     g34 = Tall[, 4] - Tall[, 3])
lv_used <- fit[, .(n_lv = uniqueN(rating5)), by = user_idx]
gaps_fs <- gaps_e[lv_used[n_lv == 5L], on = "user_idx"]
cat(sprintf("fully-identified users: %d / %d (%.1f%%)\n",
            nrow(gaps_fs), nU, 100 * nrow(gaps_fs) / nU))

sp <- rbind(
  data.table(model = "M2b", gap = c("1|2\u21922|3", "2|3\u21923|4", "3|4\u21924|5"),
             width = diff(th_b)),
  data.table(model = "M2c", gap = c("1|2\u21922|3", "2|3\u21923|4", "3|4\u21924|5"),
             width = diff(m2c_par$Theta)),
  data.table(model = "M2d", gap = c("1|2\u21922|3", "2|3\u21923|4", "3|4\u21924|5"),
             width = diff(th_d)),
  data.table(model = "M2e*", gap = c("1|2\u21922|3", "2|3\u21923|4", "3|4\u21924|5"),
             width = c(median(gaps_fs$g12), median(gaps_fs$g23), median(gaps_fs$g34))))
sp[, share := width / sum(width), by = model]
sp[, model := factor(model, levels = c("M2b", "M2c", "M2d", "M2e*"))]
p5 <- ggplot(sp, aes(model, share, fill = gap)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", share)),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 3, colour = "white") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#88BDE6", "#5B8FF9", "#1F5FA8")) +
  theme_pub() +
  labs(title = "Unequal threshold spacing survives four estimation routes",
       subtitle = "Share of the total latent span taken by each gap. The 3|4\u21924|5 gap is widest everywhere.\nM2e*: median over the 1,759 users who used all five rating levels (fully identified thresholds).",
       x = NULL, y = "Share of total span", fill = "Gap")
print(p5)
save_fig("p05_threshold_spacing.png", p5, w = 6.3, h = 3.8)
```

### 5.7 What personalised distributions look like


```{r p7-examples, fig.height=3.4}
um <- fit[, .(mean_r = mean(rating5)), by = user_idx]
um <- um[user_idx %in% unique(test$user_idx)][order(mean_r)]
pick_u <- um[round(nrow(um) * c(0.10, 0.50, 0.90)), user_idx]
rows <- sapply(pick_u, function(u) which(test$user_idx == u)[1])

ex <- rbindlist(lapply(seq_along(rows), function(k) {
  j <- rows[k]
  rbind(data.table(case = k, model = "M1",  rating = LEVELS5,
                   prob = tidy_probs(P_m1)[j, ]),
        data.table(case = k, model = "M2e", rating = LEVELS5,
                   prob = tidy_probs(P_m2e)[j, ]))
}))
case_lab <- sapply(seq_along(rows), function(k)
  sprintf("user mean %.2f | true rating %d",
          um[user_idx == pick_u[k], mean_r], test$rating5[rows[k]]))
ex[, case := factor(case, labels = case_lab)]
truth <- data.table(case = factor(seq_along(rows), labels = case_lab),
                    rating = test$rating5[rows])
p7 <- ggplot(ex, aes(rating, prob, fill = model)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), width = 0.62) +
  geom_vline(data = truth, aes(xintercept = rating),
             linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey35") +
  facet_wrap(~ case, nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(M1 = MODEL_COLS[["M1"]], M2e = MODEL_COLS[["M2e"]])) +
  theme_pub() +
  labs(title = "Predictive distributions bend to the user under per-user thresholds",
       subtitle = "One real test row per user; dotted line marks the realised rating.",
       x = "Rating", y = "Predicted probability", fill = NULL)
print(p7)
save_fig("p07_example_distributions.png", p7, w = 7.2, h = 3.4)
```

## 6. Confidence Estimation 



```{r confidence}
auc_mw <- function(score, positive) {          # Mann-Whitney AUC, no packages
  r <- rank(score); n1 <- sum(positive); n0 <- sum(!positive)
  (sum(r[positive]) - n1 * (n1 + 1) / 2) / (n1 * n0)
}
conf_measures <- function(P) {
  P <- tidy_probs(P)
  E1 <- as.numeric(P %*% LEVELS5)
  E2 <- as.numeric(P %*% LEVELS5^2)
  data.table(maxp    =  apply(P, 1, max),
             negent  = -(-rowSums(P * log(P))),
             negsd   = -sqrt(pmax(E2 - E1^2, 0)),
             neggini = -(1 - rowSums(P^2)))
}
y_true <- as.integer(test$rating5)
conf_tbl <- rbindlist(lapply(names(P_list), function(m) {
  P <- tidy_probs(P_list[[m]])
  correct <- max.col(P, ties.method = "first") == y_true
  cm <- conf_measures(P)
  data.table(model = m,
             AUC_maxprob = auc_mw(cm$maxp,    correct),
             AUC_entropy = auc_mw(cm$negent,  correct),
             AUC_stdev   = auc_mw(cm$negsd,   correct),
             AUC_gini    = auc_mw(cm$neggini, correct),
             cat_acc     = mean(correct))
}))
conf_tbl[, model := factor(model, levels = MODEL_LEVELS)]
setorder(conf_tbl, model)
kable(conf_tbl, digits = 4,
      caption = "Confidence AUC: does the distribution's shape know when it is right? (Koren & Sill Sec. 7: Netflix 0.645 \u2192 0.708)")
fwrite(conf_tbl, file.path(OUT_DIR, "m2e_confidence_auc.csv"))
```



### Risk–coverage: the operational view


```{r p8-risk-coverage, fig.height=3.8}
rc <- rbindlist(lapply(c("M1", "M2c", "M2e"), function(m) {
  P <- tidy_probs(P_list[[m]])
  correct <- max.col(P, ties.method = "first") == y_true
  mp  <- apply(P, 1, max)
  o   <- order(-mp)
  cs  <- cumsum(correct[o]) / seq_along(o)
  cov <- seq_along(o) / length(o)
  keep <- round(seq(0.02, 1, length.out = 120) * length(o))
  data.table(model = m, coverage = cov[keep], accuracy = cs[keep])
}))
rc[, model := factor(model, levels = MODEL_LEVELS)]
p8 <- ggplot(rc, aes(coverage, accuracy, colour = model)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = MODEL_COLS) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
  theme_pub() +
  labs(title = "Selective prediction: accuracy vs. coverage",
       subtitle = "Predictions ranked by max probability. Steeper left end = confidence is informative.",
       x = "Coverage (fraction of test rows kept)", y = "Category accuracy on kept rows",
       colour = NULL)
print(p8)
save_fig("p08_confidence_risk_coverage.png", p8, w = 7.0, h = 4.0)
```

## 7. Calibration / Reliability 


```{r p9-reliability, fig.height=3.9}
rel <- rbindlist(lapply(c("M1", "M2c", "M2e"), function(m) {
  P <- tidy_probs(P_list[[m]])
  mp <- apply(P, 1, max)
  correct <- max.col(P, ties.method = "first") == y_true
  br <- cut(mp, unique(quantile(mp, seq(0, 1, 0.1))), include.lowest = TRUE)
  dt <- data.table(mp = mp, correct = correct, bin = br)
  dt[, .(claimed = mean(mp), realised = mean(correct), n = .N),
     by = bin][n >= 50][, model := m][]
}))
rel[, model := factor(model, levels = MODEL_LEVELS)]
p9 <- ggplot(rel, aes(claimed, realised, colour = model)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey55") +
  geom_point(size = 1.9) + geom_line(linewidth = 0.6, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = MODEL_COLS) +
  coord_equal(xlim = range(c(rel$claimed, rel$realised)),
              ylim = range(c(rel$claimed, rel$realised))) +
  theme_pub() +
  labs(title = "Reliability of the claimed probability",
       subtitle = "Decile bins of predicted max probability. Dashed = perfect calibration.",
       x = "Claimed probability (bin mean)", y = "Realised hit rate", colour = NULL)
print(p9)
save_fig("p09_confidence_calibration.png", p9, w = 6.4, h = 5.0)

ece <- rel[, .(ECE = sum(n * abs(claimed - realised)) / sum(n)), by = model]
kable(ece, digits = 4, caption = "Expected calibration error (lower is better)")
fwrite(ece, file.path(OUT_DIR, "m2e_calibration_ece.csv"))
```

### 7.1 Sharpness–Calibration Trade-off 



```{r sharpness-diagnosis}
# Max probability distributions
mps <- list(M1 = apply(tidy_probs(P_list$M1), 1, max),
            M2c = apply(tidy_probs(P_list$M2c), 1, max),
            M2e = apply(tidy_probs(P_list$M2e), 1, max))
lo <- max(sapply(mps, min)); hi <- min(sapply(mps, max))

sharp <- rbindlist(lapply(names(mps), function(m) {
  mp <- mps[[m]]
  data.table(model = factor(m, levels = MODEL_LEVELS),
             mean_maxprob = mean(mp), sd_maxprob = sd(mp),
             min = min(mp), max = max(mp), n = length(mp))
}))

# ECE on common support only
ece_c <- rbindlist(lapply(c("M1", "M2c", "M2e"), function(m) {
  P <- tidy_probs(P_list[[m]])
  mp <- apply(P, 1, max)
  correct <- (max.col(P, ties.method = "first") == y_true)
  ok <- mp >= lo & mp <= hi
  cr <- correct[ok]; mpk <- mp[ok]
  d <- data.table(mpk, cr, br = cut(mpk, seq(lo, hi, length.out = 11),
                                    include.lowest = TRUE))[
    , .(claimed = mean(mpk), realised = mean(cr), n = .N), by = br][n >= 50]
  data.table(model = factor(m, levels = MODEL_LEVELS),
             ECE_all = ece[model == m, ECE],
             ECE_common = sum(d$n * abs(d$claimed - d$realised)) / sum(d$n),
             coverage_in_common = mean(ok))
}))

sharp_cmp <- merge(sharp[, .(model, mean_maxprob, min, max)],
                   ece_c[, .(model, ECE_all, ECE_common, coverage_in_common)],
                   by = "model")
kable(sharp_cmp, digits = 4,
      caption = sprintf("Sharpness: max-prob distributions and ECE. Common support [%.4f, %.4f].",
                        lo, hi))
cat(sprintf("\nInterpretation: M2e's ECE on all data is %.4f, but only %.4f on the common support.\n",
            ece_c[model == "M2e", ECE_all],
            ece_c[model == "M2e", ECE_common]))
cat(sprintf("M2e makes bold claims beyond M1/M2c's comfort zone (coverage %.1f%% overlap).\n",
            100 * ece_c[model == "M2e", coverage_in_common]))
```

```{r}
sapply(P_list[c("M2b","M2c")], function(P) {
  P <- tidy_probs(P); mu <- as.numeric(P %*% LEVELS5)
  dv <- outer(rep(1, nrow(P)), LEVELS5) - mu
  mean(sqrt(pmax(rowSums(P * dv^2), 1e-12)))
})
```
